description: Shrink images for page speed: fetch each one as the Site Audit crawler does, resize it to max_width (never enlarging), compress it to WebP (or keep its type, with format "original" and by default where the file is replaced in place) and step it down toward the 200 KB large_images limit without visible loss. Returns a private download link (48 h) per image, sizes before and after, and a paste-ready tag. Billing: 1¢ per 5 images optimized (rounded up per call); free when an image saves under 10 KB or 10%, when browsers already get a WebP/AVIF under 200 KB from an image CDN like next/image (reason served_optimized), for errors and skipped files, and for the same image and settings again within 24h. Returns charged_cents. 300 images an hour per workspace. When to call: after get_crawl_issue(large_images) — site_id optimizes the crawl's images over 200 KB, largest first — or with urls for any public image. Inputs: urls — 1–20 image URLs. Or: site_id — the AuditAE site id (from list_sites): its latest crawl's large_images. run_id — optional crawl run; limit (default 10, max 20) and offset (pass next_offset). max_width — 320–3840, default 1920; to reach 200 KB it may narrow, never under 1280 px. format — webp or original (same type and file name, for site builders with fixed URLs). Default webp; original on a WordPress site, for /wp-content/uploads/ images and next/image or i0.wp.com sources. quality — 40–95, the starting lossy quality. Returns: { items: [{ url, source_url?, status: optimized|optimized_still_over_limit|already_optimized|skipped|failed|not_processed, reason?, before, after, saved_bytes, saved_pct, quality_used, browsers_receive?, download_url?, filename, expires_at, snippet?, references_to_update, referrers?, billed, repeat_free? }], totals, charged_cents, next_offset?, note, next_step }. Follow next_step, then submit_urls and crawl_site to confirm. SVG and animated images (GIF, WebP, APNG) are skipped. Up to 45 s a call; unfinished images come back not_processed (free).

format.description: webp or original (keep the type and file name). Default webp; original on WordPress and for next/image or i0.wp.com sources.

limit.description: With site_id: images per call. Default 10, max 20.

max_width.description: Widest output in pixels, 320–3840. Default 1920. Never enlarges.

offset.description: With site_id: default 0. Use next_offset from the previous answer.

quality.description: Starting lossy quality, 40–95. Default: the preset (75 for photos).

run_id.description: With site_id: the crawl run. Default: the latest scored crawl.

site_id.description: AuditAE site id from list_sites: optimizes its crawl's large_images, largest first.

urls.description: 1–20 public image URLs. Use this or site_id.

name: optimize_image
title: Optimize images: resize and compress to WebP, with download links
